author: Rome News-Tribune
title: CRIME REPORTS: Rome man charged with assault - NewsBreak
text:
11 hours ago Floyd County Jail A Rome man was arrested Tuesday for throwing an open pocket knife at another man during an altercation on Pine Street in North Rome on Aug. 7, reports state.
According to Floyd County Jail reports:
Matthew Paul Chambers, 41, is charged with felony aggravated assault and misdemeanor criminal trespass. He remained in jail without bond as of Wednesday.
Traffic stop leads to meth charges for East Rome woman
An East Rome woman pulled over for her brake lights not working on Hull Avenue Tuesday night had meth and a glass smoking device in her car, police said.
According to Floyd County Jail reports:
Robin Renee Crawford-Jameson, 64, is charged with felony possession of meth as well as misdemeanor possession of drug-related objects and having broken brake lights. She remained in jail without bond as of Wednesday.
Task force busts 3 on Calhoun Avenue
Three people were arrested on Calhoun Avenue on drug charges following the execution of a search warrant by the Rome-Floyd Metro Task Force, reports state.
According to Floyd County Jail reports:
Montana Keunn Fisher, 56; Myranda Leigh Smith, 34; and Tatyana Dashawn Brown, 50; are charged with felony possession of meth as well as misdemeanor possession of gabapentin and possession of drug-related objects.
The trio remained in jail as of Wednesday.
Adam Carey, staff writer
